user_requests: Check Black Mimir conversational storytelling, speech fidelity and 120+ techniques in recent delivery
Check fidelity of Runeterra world and region/lore depiction

narration.actual_catalog: PRESENTATION.md authorizes 140 optional/cataloged techniques: 20 core approved plus 120 additional variants, selectively chosen by actual scene need; catalog existence is not proof implementation.
narration.voice_baseline: Black Mimir is sole first-person ordinary narrator post-Ragnarok/post-Valhalla with Scottish/Celtic and Chicago personal rhythm, insight, skepticism, unexpected emotional generosity, fallibility and situational profanity. He has no physical exterior body, scene-file awareness, future knowledge, automatic private access or actor-knowledge transfer. Billy alone narrates specials; Deadpool's prior one-time hijack is already completed.

comparisons.observed: Mostly neutral third-person action and explanatory transitions, with an occasional 'Aye' and moral aside; repeated defensive lines explaining what is not happening.
comparisons.finding: Narration is legible but his subjective voice, digressions, sharp first-person judgments, misapprehensions and recoveries are too scarce; 'Aye' alone does not constitute Black Mimir.

comparisons.observed: 'Somebody had killed their ransom' is an effective outcome-first cold opening. 'I'd been wondering how long they could make a dead man look wealthy instead of dead' briefly reveals the narrator's present personal amused speculation.
comparisons.finding: Two distinctive beats amid mostly neutral scene and speech attributions. The opening is a valid information-control hook; not proof of 140-tool implementation. The sequel seldom exploits purposeful parallelism, focalized misread, selective delay, dialogue subtext, changing motif, genuine danger-to-comedy modulation or evolving callbacks.

narration.failure_mode: Technique library retrieval was treated as a checklist capability, not a scene/paragraph design toolkit, while audience heard straightforward neutral battle summary, repetitive transition/exposition, stand-alone quips and little developed subjective storytelling.
narration.repair: Begin from narrative question and live focalizer; choose zero to few fitting techniques (not mandated each scene), and perform them through Mimir's genuine curiosity, uncertainty, misleading-but-fair expectation, remembered grievance, sharp witnessed specificity, personal interruptions and earned vulnerable humor. Let dialog information asymmetry, status reversal, scene-to-scene rhyme, spoken motif, tempo and listener information be real causal tools. Full-text review must quote actual successful or failed passage and its replacement; avoid narrator narrating technique names or production rules.
passage_examples: E31 hook: 'Somebody had killed their ransom.' stands as one compressed outcome-first technique.
E31 'I'd been wondering...' offers authentic first person but no extended subjective role beyond that.
E30 repeats status/access disclaimers that production review should handle instead of audience-facing exposition.
narration.claim_limit: No measured audio, formal counting of every technique on the page, or external audition of Alastair Duncan performance. No 140/140 use required.

confirmed_fits: Official Noxus has many independent warbands and strength-based social mobility; S31 hired mercenary company's pay dispute is locally plausible original fiction, not a named canon event.
Military weapons, fortified settlements, opportunistic private houses and covert plotting fit Noxus themes in broad terms.

Katarina is canonically decisive, extremely skilled and mission-driven; an independent assassination can be compatible as invented crossover scenario, but Odran and Veylan are not externally verified lore characters.
material_gaps: The Noxian culture as actually heard on E30–31 is mostly an interchangeable guard/mercenary roadblock, an isolated bridge, generic rich lord house and standard courtyard firefight; missing meritocracy-versus-nobility tension, mixed-origin warbands, individual soldier motivations, magical talent, frontier assimilation, architecture and strategic faction pressure.

The E30 bridge dispute has a generic captain and refugees without enough distinct Noxian warmasons, engineering interests, regional stakes or credible institutional consequences to communicate why this is Noxus rather than another medieval state.

E31 invents 'provincial governor', assassination order, paid company and a strongroom without source-based specific Noxian legal/command structure. They may be legitimate branch fiction but must NOT be stated as established Riot facts. Their precise regional locale and legal authority remain unsupported.

Katarina's E31 narrow daggers/competence/duty are compatible broadly, but no developed examination of her unique Du Couteau, Swain/Black Rose Noxian political identity or Shunpo/assassin kit; mission reason invented for this branch, not certified lore.
not_established_as_canon_contradictions: Generic original named Noxian mercenary captain and lord are not independently a lore contradiction merely because Riot has no Odran/Veylan.
Presence of invented bribery and court plot is compatible speculative crossover plotting unless portrayed as preexisting known Riot event.
Lack of a source mention in one story is not proof of canonical nonexistence.
runeterra.priority: Before entering any Runeterra region, retrieve actual region/place/faction/character owner and selected chronology; distinguish Riot fact, current branch divergence, original invention and unverified inference. Carry distinctive terrain, class, magic, economic/military institutions and native competing actors into real choices, not narrator lecture. Preserve portal/travel/geography limits and source-specific ability rules.
runeterra.coverage: Focused latest E30–31 Noxus against primary Riot sources; NOT a full Seasons1–3 scene-by-scene Arcane, every region, every champion or canon timeline verification.

cross_work.playback: Paused E32. Zid's betrayal/TPP joining is an author-selected FUTURE enacted development, not something E31 secretly accomplished. Do not invent travel.

result: Source owner recovery and live manuscript comparisons give clear repairs. Their effectiveness remains UNTESTED until a subsequently reviewed episode.
